_note: AGENT = Claude Code (Opus 5.5 via Bedrock) instead of Codex; same workload, goldens and judge as the Codex case. Kimi-K3 open-ended optimizer case, CHUNKED PREFILL variant: ONE MLA decoder layer on sglang v0.5.20, B200, cookbook production shape (12 heads/rank, trtllm_mla prefill backend: MHA_CHUNKED_KV = TRT-LLM ragged fp8 attention over the chunk + chunked prefix-KV attention merged with merge_state, fp8_e4m3 latent KV written per token, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 experts). Points are prefill chunks (EXTEND): B requests x L NEW tokens on a <prefix>-token cached context. Metric = eager step time. Correctness = output + the written fp8 KV rows vs a seeded golden from the pristine tree. Driver runs with --bf16-gemm-init (production scheduler's bf16 GEMM backend init: auto -> cutedsl TGV/split-K dispatch on SM100); the original decode cases keep the legacy cuBLAS-only dispatch (measured effect <= 0.7%).

render.METRIC: eager chunked-prefill step latency of one Kimi-K3 MLA decoder layer
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one MLA (dense multi-head latent attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, cutedsl_mla decode over a paged fp8 latent KV, 112 local mxfp4 experts)
render.WORKLOAD: chunked prefill (ForwardMode.EXTEND), one chunk per step: 1 request x 16,384 new tokens as the 4th chunk of a 64k prompt (primary: prefix 49,152 cached fp8 latent-KV tokens attended through the chunked-prefix path, plus causal attention within the chunk; the MoE sees ~32k local rows), plus the same 16k chunk as a FIRST chunk (prefix 0) and a mixed batch of 4 requests x 4,096 first-chunk tokens (must not regress)
